heroTitle: A story for the question you're carrying.
heroDescription: Four themes. Seven gentle questions. Six illustrated pages. BaZi and Zi Wei are calculated in your browser; details are saved only with account consent.
heroAlt: A small white fox sits beside a glowing lantern on a stone riverbank beneath a pale-gold moon.
calmerSubtitle: A short, thoughtful experience to help you see things a little more clearly.
stepOneText: Choose love, money, career or people, then share a few thoughts through seven simple questions.
stepTwoText: Receive a six-page illustrated story, created just for you.
stepThreeText: Take a moment with the insights that resonate, at your own pace.
privacyBannerTitle: You control saved answers; charts stay in your browser
privacyBannerText: If you consent to account storage, Haku saves your selected theme, the state and focus chosen within it, birth details, optional gender and duration for prefill and browser-side story generation. The option is selected by default before you begin; clear it to keep answers in this session only. Saved details can be edited, exported or deleted; Zi Wei charts are never stored.
disclaimer: For reflection and entertainment. Not medical, financial or legal advice.
privacyIntro: This note explains how Haku handles information on this website and in the Telegram Mini App.
answersTitle: Your reading answers and browser-only chart
answersText: With current account consent, Haku saves your selected theme, the state and focus chosen within that theme, birth date, birth time or unknown-time choice, birth place, solar-term answer, optional gender and duration. Gender is used only for Zi Wei decade direction. We use these answers to prefill future readings and generate your story in the browser. The chart itself is not sent to or stored by the server. Without consent, answers stay only in the current Mini App session.
accountTitle: Account information saved when you start reading
accountText: For a verified user without current consent, account and reading-detail storage is selected by default below Begin the story. Opening the page or verifying Telegram does not save anything. Only when you begin while it remains selected, or choose Save in My account, do we record consent and save Telegram ID, language, source Bot, visit times, selected theme, its state and focus, birth details, optional gender and duration. Details remain with the account until HAKU_RETENTION_DAYS of inactivity, can be edited in My account, and are included in account export or deletion. Zi Wei charts stay in the browser.
retentionText: Account records are automatically deleted {retentionDays} days after your last use.
choicesText: At any time, open My account in the Mini App to use “Download my data” or “Delete my account”.
cookiesText: This website does not use cookies and does not load third-party resources. The Mini App uses one necessary login cookie to maintain your session.
logsText: This website and the Mini App are delivered through Cloudflare, and our web server keeps access logs. Both process your IP address to deliver pages and protect the service. Only owner-role administrators can open individual saved reading details, including the selected theme, its state and focus, birth details and optional gender; every view is recorded in the audit log with the target Telegram ID, time and IP address. Zi Wei charts are not stored. Audit logs also cover administrator sign-ins, failures and account exports.
adminText: The admin area is limited to named administrator accounts. The system records administrator sign-ins, failed sign-in attempts, sign-outs, and data exports in its audit log.
contactText: For privacy questions, contact us at {contactEmail}.
termsIntro: These general terms apply when you use Haku.
termsPurposeText: Haku is for self-reflection and entertainment. It does not provide medical, investment, or legal advice, and no result or outcome is guaranteed.
termsTelegramText: When you access Haku through Telegram, you must follow Telegram’s applicable terms of use.
termsChangesText: These terms may be updated. The current version will be published on this page.
notFoundText: This page may have moved, or the address may be incorrect.
